wrong.why: The verse identifies Zedekiah as son of Hananiah, matching hananiah-13, the court official's father, rather than hananiah-10, the prophet.

note: All plain family statements are already recorded in at least one direction. The owner's Jerahmeel ruling accords with the Hebrew בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ, 'son of the king.'
